entries.title: Amadis in Translation (Digital Amadis)
entries.institution: University of Pittsburgh at Greensburg (Stacey Triplette, Elisa Beshero-Bondar) and Universidade de Santiago de Compostela (Helena Bermúdez Sabel)
entries.notes: Digital study of the transformation of Montalvo's Amadís de Gaula across editions and translations (Spanish, French, English, from the 1500s to the early 1800s). The corpus files are the 35 TEI XML chapters of the 1547 Sevilla printing of Montalvo's Amadís (facsimile source: Biblioteca Virtual de Andalucía), used to align Garci Rodríguez de Montalvo's text with Robert Southey's 1803 translation and study translation shifts. Project team: Stacey Triplette, Elisa Beshero-Bondar, Helena Bermúdez Sabel; maintained by Beshero-Bondar since 2015. Code and TEI data: https://github.com/ebeshero/Amadis-in-Translation (AGPL-3.0); archive DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.10892444. Project documentation and a 1533 frontispiece facsimile on the project site. entries.title: Grand Tour digital — TEI dataset of early modern travel testimonies (Grand Tour TEI)
entries.institution: Herzog August Bibliothek Wolfenbüttel
entries.notes:
TEI-XML files underlying the digital edition of a corpus of early modern travel testimonies (Reiseselbstzeugnisse). Full text was created with Transkribus HTR plus NER, i.e. project-released corrected machine text, published as an open dataset (CC BY-SA 4.0) on 30 September 2026. The corpus spans the 16th–18th centuries, so only part falls within the catalogue window; the dedicated edition website was not located, so the Zenodo deposit (and the git.hab.de repository it points to) is the stable access point.

Justification: A brand-new (September 2026) Zenodo deposit of corrected HTR/TEI full text of early modern travel accounts produced by a DFG-funded project (2022–2025, project no. 469982284) at the Herzog August Bibliothek. Found via a Zenodo search for recent early modern TEI editions. Not in the catalogue.
Found at: https://zenodo.org/records/23055358
